subagents.name: self
subagents.description: Subagent that inherits the parent agent's full configuration including tools, system prompt, and model. Use when you need to run a task in a separate conversation context but with the same capabilities as the current agent.

subagents.name: research
subagents.description: Research subagent with read-only tools for exploring the codebase, searching the web, and reading files. Delegate to this agent when you need to run a task in a separate conversation context, when a research task requires many search and file-reading steps that would clutter context, or when you need a broad survey of the codebase or documentation.

subagents.name: image-generator
subagents.description: Generates or edits images from a brief and replies with the saved file paths.
